description: Which credential type each identity presents, for the busiest identities (12 at most). Only Elasticsearch requests record a credential type, so identities seen only in Kibana or only anonymously are not on this chart. Rows keep about the height twelve would have, from the top, so a short window does not stretch a few identities into tall blocks.

text.expr: length(data('rows')) ? '' : 'No activity for this selection in this time range'

url.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.authentication.type IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, attributes.authentication.type | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | EVAL auth = CASE(attributes.authentication.type == "api_key", "API key", attributes.authentication.type == "token", "Token", attributes.authentication.type == "realm", "Realm", attributes.authentication.type == "saml", "SAML", attributes.authentication.type == "anonymous", "Anonymous", attributes.authentication.type == "internal", "Internal", attributes.authentication.type) | STATS events = SUM(events) BY actor, auth | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 2000 | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE "[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}" AND NOT actor RLIKE "[0-9]{20}"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), "… · Cloud API key"), actor)
